issues.title: QA — Studio runs QA when the builder is idle
issues.body: When the Studio has nothing to build, let it run a QA session.

issues.title: QA — COMET DRIFT GP: polish pass 2 (drift steer, camera in traffic, own font)
issues.body: Second polish pass on COMET DRIFT GP (#419 → #435 shipped as f2fd59c). Live at https://www.jalfern.com/retrogames/comet-drift. The identity work is done (canyon strata, screen-fill, camera, HUD cluster, slipstream) — this is what's still short of docs/ART.md and of a Road-Rash-class feel:

issues.title: QA — COMET DRIFT GP: polish pass (rival articulation, boost FOV kick, crowd rim, tier chirps)
issues.body: Polish pass for COMET DRIFT GP (shipped via #425), measured against docs/ART.md and the original it evokes (SNES-era Mode 7 kart racers). What is already good: the dusk look, dash-free drift ladder, minimap, charge pips, attract autopilot, sound on every action. Still short of the bar:

issues.body: Played `/bards-tale` cold in the built-in browser (desktop keyboard + mouse): through Skara Brae, into the Review Board, down the sewer grate, and one fight with a Giant Rat in THE WINE CELLARS.

issues.title: QA — LEMMINGS-LITE: first-time player pass (clicks dead on left half, climber charges wasted, skill bar over the lemmings)
issues.body: Played `/lemmings` cold in the built-in browser (desktop mouse + keyboard, 1024x768 viewport) on 1. THE SPIRE.
